title: An API reference and an image-model listing endpoint
summary:
A new API reference and image-model listing endpoint landed alongside model-registry fixes and tighter image queues.

Enter added a Scalar API reference covering generation requests, image parameters, model listings, and structured errors. A new `/api/generate/image/models` endpoint lists image models, and request validation now covers more generation parameters and image defaults.

Enter registered `gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07`, fixing requests that failed because its ID was missing. Pricing definitions now use dollar-per-token rates, while image usage tracking reads the model and image-token count from response headers when available.

Seedream now requires Flower access, and Kontext was removed from the available image models. Nano-banana and Seedream received longer queue intervals and lower Flower and Nectar concurrency caps; token-authenticated requests now share a queue by IP address.

highlights.title: List image models by API
highlights.text: Use `/api/generate/image/models` to retrieve the available image models programmatically.
